CITY COUNCIL MEETING
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA CITY COUNCIL MEETING
October 25, 2022 –
6:30
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
INVOCATION: Pastor Dan Pryor, Neighborhood Life Church
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE: VFW Post 9148
4.
ROLL CALL:
Councilmember Eng
Councilmember Lewis
Councilmember Sarega
Mayor Pro Tem De Ruse
Mayor Otero
5.
APPEARANCES, PRESENTATIONS, AND PROCLAMATIONS
5.1
PROCLAMATION FOR RED RIBBON WEEK – It is recommended the City Council proclaim October 24, 2022 through October 28, 2022 as Red Ribbon Week in the City of La Mirada and present a proclamation to Safety Education Officer Mary Cipres.
5.1 Proclamation
5.2
RECOGNITION OF CALIFORNIA INK, PRINTING & GRAPHICS - It is recommended the City Council present Bill Sanders, owner of California Ink, Printing & Graphics, with a Certificate of Appreciation and two tickets to the La Mirada Theatre for the Performing Arts.
5.2 Recognition of California Ink, Printing & Graphics
5.3
RECOGNITION OF LOS ANGELES COUNTY SHERIFF'S DEPARTMENT DEPUTIES STEPHEN ALVARADO AND MIGUEL VALDOVINOS – It is recommended the City Council recognize Los Angeles County Sheriff's Deputies Stephen Alvarado and Miguel Valdovinos and present them with their 10851 Award Pins and Certificates of Recognition.
5.3 Recognition of La Mirada Deputies
5.4
RECOGNITION OF PUBLIC SAFETY POSTER CONTEST WINNERS - It is recommended the City Council recognize the winners of the Public Safety Poster Contest and present them with Certificates of Recognition.
5.4 Recognition of PS Poster Contest Winners
5.5
RECOGNITION OF CITY EMPLOYEE FOR YEARS OF SERVICE – It is recommended the City Council recognize Elyse Macias for her years of service and present her with a service award pin and a Certificate of Appreciation.
5.5 Recognition of City Employee
6.
PUBLIC COMMENT
7.
CONSENT CALENDAR: (All items listed on the Consent Calendar are considered to be routine matters, status reports or subjects covered previously by the City Council. Items listed on the Consent Calendar may be enacted in one motion.)
7.1
APPROVAL OF MEETING MINUTES - It is recommended the City Council approve the minutes of the Study Session Meeting of October 11, 2022 and the minutes of the regular City Council meeting of October 11, 2022.
7.1 Minutes of 10-11-22 SS
7.1 Minutes of 10-11-22 CC
7.2
APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTER - It is recommended the City Council approve the warrant register dated October 25, 2022 in the total amount of $3,726,157.42.
7.2 Warrant Register
7.3
MONTHLY TREASURER REPORT FOR THE PERIOD ENDING AUGUST 2022 - It is recommended the City Council receive and file the City of La Mirada Monthly Treasurer Report for the period ending August 2022.
7.3 Treasurer Report
7.4
INVESTMENT REPORT FOR THE CITY OF LA MIRADA FOR THE MONTH ENDING SEPTEMBER 2022 - It is recommended the City Council receive and file the City’s Investment Report for the month ending September 2022.
7.4 Investment Report
7.5
APPROVAL OF FACILITY USE FOR THE RELAY FOR LIFE FUNDRAISING EVENT AT THE LA MIRADA ACTIVITY CENTER – It is recommended the City Council approve the use of the Activity Center for the Relay for Life fundraising event.
7.5 Approval of Facility Use
7.6
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2017-09, MEDIAN LANDSCAPE IMPROVEMENTS FOR VALLEY VIEW AVENUE FROM IMPERIAL HIGHWAY TO ROSECRANS AVENUE – ACCEPTANCE OF WORK - It is recommended the City Council accept the improvements constructed by Southern California Landscape, Inc.; authorize the City Clerk to file a Notice of Completion with the County Recorder; and authorize the payment of retention monies pursuant to the agreement.
7.6 CIP No. 2017-09
7.7
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2018-07, SANTA GERTRUDES AVENUE CORRIDOR TRAFFIC SIGNAL UPGRADES – REVIEW OF BIDS AND REJECTION OF ALL BIDS - It is recommended the City Council reject all bids for Capital Improvement Project No. 2018-07, Santa Gertrudes Avenue Corridor Traffic Signal Upgrades and authorize the City Clerk to re-advertise for sealed bids.
7.7 CIP No. 2018-07
8.
PUBLIC HEARINGS
8.1
RESOLUTION NO. 22-25 AUTHORIZING A BUDGET AMENDMENT TO FUND THE NEFF HISTORICAL SITE RESTORATION PROJECT PHASE TWO UNDER THE COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT BLOCK GRANT (CDBG) PROGRAM - It is recommended the City Council conduct a public hearing and adopt Resolution No. 22-25 authorizing a $206,441 budget amendment to fund the Neff Restoration Project Phase Two with CDBG Funds.
8.1 PH: Reso. No. 22-25
9.
ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS
9.1
SECOND READING AND ADOPTION OF ORDINANCE NO. 725 APPROVING DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT NO. 16 AND A SITE PLAN REVIEW TO INSTALL AN ELECTRONIC BILLBOARD ON VACANT PROPERTY LOCATED AT 14500 FIRESTONE BOULEVARD, WITHIN THE FREEWAY COMMERCIAL (C-F) ZONING DISTRICT– It is recommended the City Council accept for second reading and adopt Ordinance No. 725 approving Development Agreement No. 16 allowing the installation of an electronic billboard on vacant property located at 14500 Firestone Boulevard, within the Freeway Commercial (C-F) Zoning District, by title only, and waive further reading.
9.1 Ord. No. 725 - 2nd Rdg
9.2
SECOND READING AND ADOPTION OF ORDINANCE NO. 726 APPROVING DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT NO. 17 AND A SITE PLAN REVIEW TO INSTALL AN ELECTRONIC BILLBOARD ON VACANT PROPERTY LOCATED AT 14500 FIRESTONE BOULEVARD, WITHIN THE FREEWAY COMMERCIAL (C-F) ZONING DISTRICT - It is recommended the City Council accept for second reading and adopt Ordinance No. 726 approving Development Agreement No. 17 allowing the installation of an electronic billboard on vacant property located at 14500 Firestone Boulevard, within the Freeway Commercial (C-F) Zoning District, by title only, and waive further reading.
9.2 Ord. No. 726 - 2nd Rdg
